parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing restriction is documented: no presentation offence, no border or document friction, no birth-sex facility rule, no police targeting. Positives include self-declaration recognition (climate signal), marriage equality passed by referendum, a hate-speech provision, an anti-discrimination regime, a 2026 national action plan on LGBTIQ hate crime, and support services — evidence of acceptance and institutional protection. Negatives: Article 261bis frames hate crime on sexual orientation not gender identity, bias motivation is poorly recorded, reports are rising (raw counts, no denominator), and detention placement is cantonal with only one canton's text carried — an open question, not an exposure. No non-binary marker exists, a minor visitor-facing gap. No trans-specific violence data in either direction. Net: functioning protections with documented enforcement gaps, sitting in the low-risk band below the strongest acceptance-plus-enforcement anchors.
